description: This file implements server-side request handling for the control UI, including routing, static asset serving, security headers, and avatar URL resolution.

methods.name: contentTypeForExt
methods.description: Returns the MIME type for a given file extension.

methods.name: respondControlUiAssetsUnavailable
methods.description: Responds with a 503 error indicating control UI assets are missing.

methods.name: respondHeadForFile
methods.description: Handles HEAD requests for static files, setting headers and ending response.

methods.name: isValidAgentId
methods.description: Validates agent ID against a regex pattern.

methods.name: serveResolvedFile
methods.description: Serves a static file with appropriate headers.

methods.name: serveResolvedIndexHtml
methods.description: Serves the index.html content with CSP headers if inline scripts are present.

methods.name: isExpectedSafePathError
methods.description: Checks if an error is a safe path error (ENOENT, ENOTDIR, ELOOP).

methods.name: resolveSafeAvatarFile
methods.description: Safely opens and verifies an avatar file, returning its path and file descriptor.

methods.name: resolveSafeControlUiFile
methods.description: Safely opens and verifies a control UI file within a boundary root.

methods.name: isSafeRelativePath
methods.description: Checks if a relative path is safe (not absolute, no parent directory traversal, no null bytes).

methods.name: handleControlUiHttpRequest
methods.description: Main handler for control UI HTTP requests, routing, serving files, and fallback.

methods.name: buildControlUiCspHeader
methods.description: Builds Content Security Policy header for control UI.

methods.name: computeInlineScriptHashes
methods.description: Computes hashes for inline scripts for CSP.
